pr_title: [BugFix]Fix multi-DP deadlock for extract_hidden_states proposer on MoE targets
source_quote: Check whether the synchronization operation here affects the graph mode.

rule.description: 在数据并行（DP）环境中，speculative decoding 的 proposer 必须通过 `_sync_metadata_across_dp` 同步所有 DP rank 的 cudagraph_mode，避免因 graph mode 不一致导致设备端集合通信失步和死锁。

antipattern.code:
# （根据评审意见推断）多 DP 场景下缺少 _sync_metadata_across_dp 调用
# lilinsiman 评论: "Check whether the synchronization operation here
#                   affects the graph mode."
# 不同 DP rank 的 num_tokens 不一致，cudagraph_mode 不同步，引发死锁

class AscendExtractHiddenStatesProposer:
    def _determine_batch_execution_and_padding(
        self,
        num_tokens: int,
        batch_desc: Any,
        cudagraph_mode: Any,
        use_cudagraphs: bool,
    ) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
        # SP padding must happen BEFORE DP sync (matches the main runner)
        num_tokens = self.runner._pad_for_sequence_parallelism(num_tokens)

        # 直接读取本地 DP rank 的 num_tokens，未进行 DP 间同步
        num_tokens_across_dp = self.runner.get_num_tokens_across_dp()
        if num_tokens_across_dp is not None:
            num_tokens_padded = int(num_tokens_across_dp[self.dp_rank].item())
            num_tokens_across_dp[self.dp_rank] = num_tokens_padded
            cudagraph_mode, batch_desc = self.cudagraph_dispatcher.dispatch(
                num_tokens_padded,
                valid_modes={cudagraph_mode},
            )
            assert batch_desc.num_tokens == num_tokens_padded
        # 直接使用本地 cudagraph_mode，未与其他 DP rank 对齐
        # 导致不同 DP rank 的 graph mode 不一致 → 设备端集合通信失步 → 死锁
        return cudagraph_mode, batch_desc

pattern.code:
# 使用 runner._sync_metadata_across_dp 同步 DP rank 间的元数据
# 确保所有 DP rank 使用一致的 cudagraph_mode，避免死锁
# 同步操作以安全方式降级 graph mode（取 DP 间最小值），不破坏 graph capture

class AscendExtractHiddenStatesProposer:
    def _determine_batch_execution_and_padding(
        self,
        num_tokens: int,
        batch_desc: Any,
        cudagraph_mode: Any,
        use_cudagraphs: bool,
    ) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
        # SP padding must happen BEFORE DP sync (matches the main runner)
        num_tokens = self.runner._pad_for_sequence_parallelism(num_tokens)

        num_tokens_across_dp = self.runner.get_num_tokens_across_dp()
        if num_tokens_across_dp is not None:
            num_tokens_padded = int(num_tokens_across_dp[self.dp_rank].item())
            # 修复: 使用 runner._sync_metadata_across_dp 同步 DP rank 间的元数据
            # is_draft_model=True 跳过不必要的 all_reduce
            # synced_cudagraph_mode 取 DP 间最小值, 安全降级 graph mode
            (
                _max_tokens_across_dp,
                num_tokens_across_dp,
                synced_cudagraph_mode,
            ) = self.runner._sync_metadata_across_dp(
                num_tokens=num_tokens_padded,
                is_draft_model=True,
                cudagraph_mode=cudagraph_mode,
                allow_dp_padding=use_cudagraphs,
            )
            # Re-dispatch with DP-synced padding
            cudagraph_mode, batch_desc = self.cudagraph_dispatcher.dispatch(
                num_tokens_padded,
                valid_modes={synced_cudagraph_mode},
            )
            assert batch_desc.num_tokens == num_tokens_padded
        return cudagraph_mode, batch_desc
